summary: VHC Talent OS - JD Parsing Bug Fix Verification Complete. All 23 backend tests pass. The 'body stream already read' bug fix is verified working.
passed_tests: - Returns single clean JSON response (no double-read issues)
- Response includes: success, title, skills, experience_years, location, input_type, parsed_by_role
- PDF file upload works correctly (extracts text with PyMuPDF)
- Unsupported file formats (jpg, xyz) return 400 with clear error message
- Empty files return 400 with 'no text could be extracted' error
- Missing input (no jd_text or jd_file) returns 400
- All errors return proper HTTP codes (400), not 500
- All fields needed for frontend autofill are present
- Required fields: success, title, skills, experience_years, location, input_type, parsed_by_role
- Optional fields: salary_min, salary_max, summary, responsibilities, requirements, raw_text
- Admin, Employer, Recruiter roles have access

bug_fix_verification.root_cause: Frontend was calling response.json() and then in error handling trying to read the response again (body stream already consumed)

fix_applied.frontend: Changed to response.text() then JSON.parse() instead of response.json() twice
fix_applied.backend: Improved error handling with proper try/finally for file cleanup

seed_data_creation: No seed data created - tests use dynamically generated test files

parse_jd_paste_mode.response: Single clean JSON with parsed fields

parse_jd_upload_mode.response: Single clean JSON with parsed fields

error_handling.missing_input: Returns 400 with 'provide jd_text or jd_file' error

mocked_apis.note: JD parsing uses real GPT-5.2 via Emergent LLM Key - NOT MOCKED

context_for_next_testing_agent: JD Parsing bug fix verified. The 'body stream already read' issue was caused by frontend reading response twice. Fix: use response.text() then JSON.parse(). Backend endpoint POST /api/jobs/parse-jd works correctly with both paste (jd_text) and upload (jd_file) modes. All 23 tests pass including 10 new tests specifically for the bug fix verification.
